summary: Master Circular Economy Strategy to eliminate waste and drive profit. Join our advanced 5-day training for leaders. Enroll now for actionable circular roadmaps.
lede: Circular economy strategy redesigns how materials move through products and operations to reduce waste and keep resources in use. This course is for senior professionals leading circular initiatives who need to turn that approach into an operational plan, from mapping material flows and identifying waste hotspots to designing for repair and reuse. It also covers take-back and product-as-a-service models, reverse logistics, and using lifecycle assessment and carbon metrics to evaluate impact.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for senior professionals who lead circular transformation initiatives and must deliver measurable business impact.
modules: Systems Thinking and Material Flow Foundations
Circular Design Principles and Product Innovation
prerequisites: Prerequisites: This advanced course requires a working knowledge of sustainability fundamentals (e.g., carbon accounting basics, ESG reporting frameworks) and professional experience in strategy, design, or supply chain management. Participants must be comfortable with data analysis and strategic planning. No coding skills are required, but familiarity with Excel or basic data visualization tools is expected. Attendees should bring a real-world business challenge or product line to apply the curriculum to during workshops.
